 Closings and Delays 13 First Alert Weather Day issued for Friday morning for dense fog, school delays possible 
 First Alert Weather Day: Friday Morning Dense Fog - Annie's First Alert Forecast (Oct. 23, 2026) By WTVG Staff and Jay Berschback Published : Oct. 22, 2026 at 4:45 PM EDT | Updated : 7 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google TOLEDO, Ohio (WTVG) - A 13 First Alert Weather Day has been issued for the morning of Friday, Oct. 23 for expected dense fog.
 The 13 First Alert Weather team expects the fog to form later in the morning, after 5 a.m., and could last as long as 10 a.m. to 11 a.m.
 Dense fog can cause issues on the roads due to reduced visibility. School delays and closings are possible Friday morning. 
 School district administrators in NW Ohio and SE Michigan submit any changes to 13 Action News. Check to see if your school district has issued any delays or closing at the link here. It’s updated in real-time.
 You can also check our interactive traffic map here. It includes access to traffic cameras to check the conditions outside.
